promptLatex: A factory makes 50 percent of its output on line A, 30 percent on line B, and 20 percent on line C. The defective rates on the three lines are 1 percent, 4 percent, and 9 percent respectively. An item taken at random from the output is found to be defective. What is the probability that it came from line C?
hintLatex: Each line contributes its share of the output multiplied by its own defective rate.
In a batch of $1000$ items the defective counts are $5$, $12$, and $18$ from the three lines.
So $35$ items in all are defective and $18$ of them came from line C.
